variants.cost: Literal k-round implementation: k independent samples, 2k exact sample-function values, k direction draws and k Bregman minimizations. Vector arithmetic and averaging are separate computational resources. No runtime, bit complexity or finite-precision guarantee is supplied.
variants.name: Smooth two-point MD
variants.output: hatθ_k=(1/k)Σ_(t=1)^k θ_t∈Θ, rather than the last iterate θ_(k+1).
public_inputs: Θ, norm and dual norm, differentiable ψ, initial θ_1∈Θ, direction law μ, positive finite R,G,L_P,M,s(d), positive multipliers α,u and integer horizon k.
variants.query_and_update: For t=1,…,k draw X_t iid P and Z_t∼μ independently of X_t and all previous draws. Query F(θ_t;X_t), F(θ_t+u_t Z_t;X_t). Set g_t=[F(θ_t+u_t Z_t;X_t)−F(θ_t;X_t)]Z_t/u_t. Compute θ_(t+1)=argmin_{θ∈Θ}{<g_t,θ>+Dψ(θ,θ_t)/α(t)}.
variants.requirements: Nonempty compact convex Θ; f=E F finite on Θ and F(·;x) closed convex P-almost surely. A: ψ is 1-strongly convex and Dψ(θ*,θ)≤R²/2 for every θ∈Θ at a minimizer θ*. B: g=∇F is measurable, E g=∇f and E||g(θ;X)||_*²≤G² uniformly on Θ. C: dom F(·;x) contains Θ+u_1 supp μ for every x; queried segments are smooth. Directions have E ZZ^T=I_d, finite M=(E||Z||^4||Z||_*²)^(1/2), and E||<a,Z>Z||_*²≤s(d)||a||_*² for every a. E: sample gradients are L(X)-Lipschitz in the primal/dual norms with finite L_P=(E L(X)²)^(1/2). Independent fresh X_t,Z_t and exact same-sample paired values and exact Bregman minimization are required.
variants.state_and_initialization: Choose any θ_1∈Θ and maintain iterates and their running sum. Dψ(a,b)=ψ(a)−ψ(b)−<∇ψ(b),a−b>.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: α(t)=α R/[2G√s(d)√t], u_t=u G√s(d)/[L_P M t]. Choose u so Assumption C holds at u_1; stop at prescribed k≥1. Only positive-denominator parameters are covered; no zero-denominator limiting rule is asserted.
